title: The cost rate of nonlinear remote stabilization on the Aubry--André lattice: a reflected off-spectral exponent and the sharp identity for almost every phase
summary: We study the exponential rate $r(α,λ)$ of the energy $\mathcal{E}_N$ needed to steer a far site, at distance $N$, of an Aubry--André chain $H_λ$ via one boundary actuator with closed-loop margin $α$. An exact eigenbasis reduction writes $\mathcal{E}_N$ as a Cauchy quadratic form $\tilde b^\top C^{-1}\tilde b$ in the boundary-amplitude ratios, whose rate is the off-spectral Lyapunov exponent of the transfer cocycle at the reflected band edge $z^\star=2E_{\min}-2α-E_{\max}$, giving $r(α,λ)=γ_λ(z^\star)$.
